description:
Where people are moving: arrivals, departures and net moves from elsewhere in Australia and from overseas, plus births, deaths and population, for every council area per year since 2016-17.

Coverage: 543 council areas; years to 30 June 2017 through 2025 (nine years). Period is the first day of the financial year. Current to 2025-06-30. Full description, field list and method: `/v1/datasets/migration`.

**Price: 5¢ per call.**

fields.description: Comma-separated subset of: net_internal_migration, internal_arrivals, internal_departures, net_overseas_migration, overseas_arrivals, overseas_departures, births, deaths, natural_increase, resident_population. Omit for all.

lga_name.description: Council (LGA) name exactly as /v1/lga/list returns it, e.g. `Lake Macquarie`.

to.description: Last period to include, same formats as `from`.

name: lga_area_stats_migration
title: LGA · Migration and population change
